description.value: Veerji Fish 'n' Grill is a BC-based Indian restaurant chain with a location on Veddar Road in Chilliwack, serving a broad menu of tandoori dishes, biryanis, chaats, and their signature fish and chicken pakoras. The chain operates franchised locations across the Fraser Valley and BC Interior, offering consistent Indian cuisine with a strong emphasis on both meat and vegetarian options. It is a sit-down and takeout option for cyclists passing through the Veddar Road corridor.
